property_summary: For any caller who is the owner, invoking NETM() leaves totalDistributed unchanged and balances(owner) equal to totalDistributed (i.e., balances[owner] == totalDistributed); the mutant wrongly increases balances[owner] by 1e18 causing balances[owner] != totalDistributed for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the NETM function body to double-assign totalDistributed to owner and also add one extra token to owner, altering balances(owner).
